baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive verb at word 1 governs the recipients, while words 3 and 6 name portable vessels and handleless cups.
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive construction centers stationary recipients while portable drinkware repeatedly moves around them, organizing hospitality as a circuit rather than a single handoff.

activation_trace.role: Circling around something supplies the repeated motion and makes it the service mechanism.
The vessel or container image supplies what the circuit carries.
The handleless cup image makes the object suited to direct passing and drinking.

changed_reading.before: Vessels are simply brought to the recipients.
changed_reading.after: A continuous service circuit keeps drinkware moving around stationary recipients.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 5-8 juxtapose silver, cups, temporal predication, and glass vessels.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reflective silver and transparent glass are not a generic luxury list: the predication marks a deliberate material contrast within one serving ensemble.

activation_trace.role: Known white silver supplies the opaque, reflective side of the material contrast.
The handleless cup identifies the particular object receiving the glass predication.
Being and temporal predication make the relation between cup and glass an asserted state, not loose decoration.
The glass-vessel image supplies the transparent, fragile side of the contrast.

changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a sensory tension between silver reflectivity and glass transparency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The moving passive at word 1 is paired with the vessel and glass terms at words 3 and 8.
baseline_models.mechanism: The service system joins outer mobility to inner containment: the vessels remain bounded and settled enough to carry a drink while the ensemble circles the recipients.

activation_trace.role: Circling supplies the mobile outer path of the service.
The container image supplies a bounded interior carried along that path.
Settling and remaining fixed contribute stability inside the moving service.

changed_reading.before: Movement and vessels are independent details.
changed_reading.after: The image depends on controlled mobility: stable containment is carried through continuous motion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The vessel noun at word 3 has dominant branches for container and due completion, plus a non-dominant mapped branch for time or occasion; word 7 explicitly predicates a state in time.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split inventory permits a weak double activation in which the vessel is also something arriving at its proper occasion or maturity, so the gift is not merely present but timely.

activation_trace.role: The dominant vessel image preserves the surface anchor.
Reaching due completion adds readiness or ripeness to the vessel image.
The non-dominant time-and-occasion branch sharpens the idea of an appointed moment.
Temporal predication gives the exploratory timing resonance a syntactic foothold.

changed_reading.before: The vessels are immediately available objects.
changed_reading.after: The vessels can also resonate as provision that has reached its fitting time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who actively fed even a bound captive while refusing human repayment become the stationary recipients of circulating service; explicit recompense turns the hospitality circuit into an ethical role reversal.

activation_trace.role: Circling supplies the reward-side service directed around the recipients.
The vessel image is the concrete object through which the reversed hospitality arrives.
Feeding another supplies the earlier outward act that the later service reverses.
Binding and captivity identify the least free recipient of the earlier generosity.
Corresponding recompense is explicitly refused from the human recipients, opening the reciprocity gap.
Corresponding recompense then supplies the divine answer that closes that gap.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from first-person active giving in 76:8-9 to passive receiving around them in 76:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies feeding, a captive, refusal of human recompense, divine recompense, and circulating vessels; I infer a measure-for-measure role reversal. A live alternative is that the service is only one undifferentiated part of reward.

changed_reading.before: The circulation is anonymous luxury service.
changed_reading.after: The circulation reciprocates earlier selfless feeding by turning givers into served recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cup-with-contents, mixture, flowing spring, and induced outburst form a source-to-container chain; the focus vessels become mobile endpoints of a controllable distribution system.

activation_trace.role: Drinking from a cup supplies the consumption endpoint of the flow network.
Circling distributes those endpoints among the recipients.
The cup together with what it contains links the vessel to an actual delivered drink.
Mixing one thing with another supplies a preparation stage before delivery.
The source of running water supplies the network's origin.
Wide splitting and release supply active control over the source's outflow.

structural_cues: The ordered sequence in 76:5-6 names cup, mixture, spring, and induced gushing before 76:15 names circulating containers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the stages but not arrows between them; I infer source, preparation, container, and delivery as one hydraulic chain. They may alternatively remain separate abundance images.

changed_reading.before: The vessels are isolated pieces of tableware.
changed_reading.after: The vessels are the mobile delivery layer of a spring-fed, mixed-drink system.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nearness, made-easy fruit, close clusters, and exact fit align with circulating vessels: the environment repeatedly removes reach, effort, and sizing friction for its recipients.

activation_trace.role: Circling brings service repeatedly into the recipients' immediate reach.
The container image supplies the fitted object delivered by that service.
Nearness supplies the spatial rule that desirable things approach the recipients.
Making something easy after difficulty supplies the removal of effort.
The picked fruit or near cluster gives the accessibility rule a concrete object.
Conformity to a fitting measure supplies recipient-sensitive sizing.

structural_cues: The repeated recipient pronoun in 76:14-15 and the passive forms place environmental adjustment, not recipient exertion, in the foreground.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proximity, facilitation, near fruit, exact fit, and circulation; I infer one affordance design centered on recipient reach and capacity. The alternative is a list of independent comforts.

changed_reading.before: The scene offers abundant luxury near the recipients.
changed_reading.after: The vessels belong to an ergonomically fitted environment that comes to each recipient at the right reach and measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated circulation joins reflective silver and transparent glass to sparkling, scattered attendants, producing a distributed moving field of light rather than separating servers from served objects.

activation_trace.role: Circling supplies the motion of the vessels.
White silver supplies one bright material surface in the moving field.
Glass vessels supply the transparent object surface in that field.
The second circling occurrence makes the attendants share the vessels' path.
Sparkling brilliance supplies the attendants' luminous appearance.
Casting things in a scattered pattern distributes that brilliance through the scene.

structural_cues: The same ط و ف root and the same عليهم relation recur in 76:15 and 76:19, first with vessels and then with attendants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated circulation and the pearl-scattering simile; I infer visual continuity between attendants and silver-glass objects. The simile may instead describe only the attendants' appearance.

changed_reading.after: Attendants and vessels form one visibly circulating, pearl-like distribution of light.

context_deltas.mechanism: Patience and the later indictment of immediacy activate the focus inventory's delay, due-completion, and occasion branches, turning the vessel into provision that arrives only after its proper interval.

activation_trace.role: The vessel branch keeps the reading attached to the focus object.
Due completion supplies the arrival of a reward at maturity.
The non-dominant time-and-occasion branch supplies an appointed interval.
Holding the self back from distress supplies the delay endured before reward.
Haste and bringing forward supply the rejected temporal opposite.

structural_cues: The reward scene begins after recompense for endurance in 76:12, while 76:27 contrasts it with love of the immediate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies patience, immediacy, and focus branches for due time and occasion; I infer that the vessel image can carry deferred readiness. The live alternative is that these sibling branches are only lexical coincidence around an ordinary vessel noun.

changed_reading.before: The vessels signify immediately available abundance.
changed_reading.after: The vessels also figure abundance delivered at its due time after disciplined delay.

context_deltas.mechanism: Punitive connected rings, collars, and captivity constrain persons; in the focus, bounded and settled containers move while recipients remain the center. Constraint is relocated from the human body to a benign vessel that enables service.

activation_trace.role: The container supplies a bounded object rather than a bound person.
Settling and fixation supply the vessel's controlled interior stability.
Circling makes the bounded object mobile around unbound recipients.
Connected links supply punitive bodily restriction.
A collar binding a limb intensifies the person-centered form of restraint.
Binding and captivity extend the bodily-restraint field into the ethical scene.

structural_cues: The punitive scene places restraints on people, whereas 76:15 grammatically moves the containers around the people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily bonds, captivity, containers, settling, and circulation; I infer a reversal in where constraint is placed. The alternative is a simple punishment-versus-reward contrast without a containment mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The cups are merely containers used in reward.
changed_reading.after: The cups enact benign containment: what is bounded now serves people instead of binding them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the coldness sibling branch beneath the glass noun and links it to explicit exclusion of both sun and severe cold. It remains anchored in the focus ق ر ر form and branch inventory; downstream prose should present it as a sensory resonance of moderated coolness, not as a replacement gloss for glass.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The glass noun at word 8 shares a root inventory with coldness and settled comfort.

activation_trace.role: The glass-vessel image preserves the noun's direct material sense.
Coldness and cooling add a restrained thermal resonance to the glassware.
The sun and its heat supply one excluded thermal extreme.
Severe cold supplies the opposite excluded thermal extreme.

changed_reading.before: Glass describes transparency and delicacy alone.
changed_reading.after: The glassware can also participate in a scene of settled coolness held between thermal extremes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model applies the surah's creation, mixture, and changed-form images to the focus's silver-glass predication. It remains anchored in the named focus materials and temporal predication; downstream prose should mark it as an analogy about transformed material categories, not a technical claim about manufacture.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 5-8 assert silver and glass within one predicated object sequence.

activation_trace.role: Silver supplies the first explicit material category.
Being and predication assert the unusual material state.
Glass vessels supply the second material category.
Measuring and proportioning a created thing supplies intentional material design.
Mixture supplies the possibility of categories combined rather than merely juxtaposed.
Changing a thing's form supplies transformation as the inferred material arrow.

changed_reading.before: Silver and glass form an ornamental paradox.
changed_reading.after: Their conjunction can image deliberately recreated material categories that are measured, mixed, or transformed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it carries the non-dominant vaulted-hall mapping of ء ن ي into an ordinary vessel noun. It remains valid as an anchored scale analogy supported by the packet's split mapping and the focus's place and glass branches; downstream prose should call it miniature-architecture imagery, never the lexical meaning of the noun here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The vessel at word 3 has a split mapped branch for a vaulted hall, while words 7-8 activate place and glass-vessel images.

activation_trace.role: The dominant vessel image keeps the analogy attached to the serving object.
The non-dominant vaulted hall or arcade image supplies an architectural scale counterpart.
Place and position allow container and built space to overlap functionally.
The glass-vessel image makes the miniature architecture transparent and portable.

changed_reading.before: The vessels are small objects located within the paradisal setting.
changed_reading.after: The vessels can weakly echo the setting as portable micro-architecture, collapsing container and inhabited space.

strongest_changes: Circulating vessels became reciprocal hospitality for people who had fed others without seeking repayment.
The tableware became the mobile endpoint of a source, mixture, container, and delivery network.
Near fruit and exact measure turned the scene into a recipient-fitted environment rather than a display of luxury.
Repeated circulation and scattered pearl brilliance joined attendants and silver-glass vessels into one moving visual field.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus ayah function simultaneously as ethical reversal, flow infrastructure, calibrated affordance, luminous choreography, and deferred provision while preserving rather than resolving its silver-glass tension.
remaining_uncertainties: The due-time reading depends on sibling and non-dominant branches of the vessel root and should remain secondary.
The thermal, recreated-material, and miniature-architecture readings are anchored analogies, not replacement lexical glosses.
The luminous continuity between attendants and vessels may be visual composition rather than a causal mechanism.
